metadata.question: Did Washington D.C. experience an air temperature difference of at least 24 degrees Celcius between January 29 and February 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about temperature difference in Washington D.C. between two specific dates in 2019. I need to: 1. Use temperature data - MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) would be appropriate 2. Define Washington D.C. geometry 3. Get temperature data for Jan 29 and Feb 5, 2019 4. Calculate the difference and check if it's at least 24°C 5. Handle cases where data might be missing For temperature data, I'll use MODIS LST (MOD11A1.061) which provides daily land surface temperature. The band 'LST_Day_1km' gives temperature in Kelvin, so I'll need to convert to Celsius. Let me structure this: - Define Washington D.C. as a point or small polygon - Get MODIS LST for both dates - Convert from Kelvin to Celsius - Calculate mean temperature for each date - Compute the absolute difference - Check if difference >= 24°C I need to handle: - Empty collections (try recovery if needed) - No valid pixels after masking - Invalid calculations ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const dc = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072]).buffer(5000); // Washington D.C. with buffer // 2. Data Acquisition const modisJan = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate('2019-01-29', '2019-01-30') .filterBounds(dc); const modisFeb = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate('2019-02-05', '2019-02-06') .filterBounds(dc); // Check for empty collections const janCount = modisJan.size().getInfo(); const febCount = modisFeb.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 29 Images: ${janCount}, Feb 5 Images: ${febCount}`); if (janCount === 0 || febCount === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get first image from each collection const janImg = modisJan.first(); const febImg = modisFeb.first(); // Convert LST from Kelvin to Celsius (scale 0.02 for MODIS) const janTemp = janImg.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); const febTemp = febImg.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // 3. Check valid pixels const janCountPixels = janTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dc, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const febCountPixels = febTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dc, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan valid pixels: ${janCountPixels}, Feb valid pixels: ${febCountPixels}`); if (janCountPixels === 0 || febCountPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate temperatures const janMean = janTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dc, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const febMean = febTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dc, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 29 Temp: ${janMean.toFixed(1)}°C, Feb 5 Temp: ${febMean.toFixed(1)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (janMean === null || febMean === null || isNaN(janMean) || isNaN(febMean)) { console.log("C3"); return; } const diff = Math.abs(janMean - febMean); console.log(`Temperature difference: ${diff.toFixed(1)}°C`); if (diff >= 24) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
